s01025.summary: Barnaby and Aloysius arrive at Fitch's counter to claim their shared trunk.
Fitch asks about the contents and Aloysius blurts out the Mortimer papers.
Fitch ceremoniously opens the trunk, revealing shirts and a Mortimer folio.
Barnaby and Aloysius collide over the pen and duel with politeness.
Hortense bursts in with Nell over a toy that was never lost.
Hortense insults the gentlemen, calling Aloysius half a man and a ghost.
Nell exposes that Hortense invented the errand to meet the mustached men.
Barnaby and Aloysius fend off Hortense, frantically claiming engagements to women.
Fitch reveals the folio is a deed to the ship they've been selling.
The two men bolt and jam in the doorway as Fitch rings for help.
Hortense announces she and Nell will buy the ship instead of ice cream.

s01096.summary: Inez leads her team silently along the catwalk toward a crouching figure.
Inez steps forward and orders the figure to put the case down.
Dorothea sends Augusto to find the chandelier cable cut-off.
Inez tries to talk the figure out of going through with it.
The figure turns out to be Violetta, a fired soprano mourning her silence.
Barnabas raises his gun at Violetta until Inez makes him lower it.
Violetta asks to sing once more and Dorothea holds the curtain.
The briefcase falls open, empty but for blank sheet music: no bomb.
Violetta sings one clear note as everyone stands still and listens.

pd_sisters_0.summary: Olga recalls their father's death and funeral a year ago.
Olga longs for Moscow and the sisters dream of moving there.
Irina glows with name-day happiness and Olga praises her beauty.
Olga admits she feels old and wishes she were married.
Tuzenbach announces Vershinin's visit and gossips about his troubled wife.
Soleni and Chebutikin wander in spouting absurd theories and remedies.

s00016.summary: A stranger rides into the creek bed where an armed young woman waits.
The Stranger asks about Cullen Pike and the woman claims ignorance.
She demands his purpose and crosses toward him, shotgun ready.
He gives his name, Jedediah, and his quip draws a startled laugh.
Odalys reveals Cullen was her father and lies buried under the bridge.
Jedediah removes his hat in silent respect before the grave.
Jedediah asks who buried Cullen and who killed him.
Odalys levels her shotgun and blames the man who sent him.

s01084.summary: Rhee and Osei examine the death scene in the drained pool.
Rhee lifts the tarp to find a single red high-heeled shoe.
Captain Voss calls to say a janitor witness is on her way.
Dolores Amadi descends into the pool, mop in hand.
Dolores describes a tall quiet man in a gray coat.
Dolores produces the second red shoe, bagged and handled with gloves.
A silhouette appears on the diving board and Rhee orders him to freeze.
The man leaps, everyone collides in a tangle, and he escapes upstairs.
Shaken Dolores tells Rhee she thinks she knows that coat.

s01027.summary: A boy at the snack counter teases tearful Dezi about her skating.
The boy brings up rumors that Dezi took her mother's car.
Junior introduces himself and shares the sad story of his name.
Dezi falls hard on the floor and both screams and laughs.
Junior slides over and they vent their family anger together.
The lights blaze on and manager Ms. Fairweather walks in, startled.
Ms. Fairweather checks on Dezi and orders her to call her mother.
Dezi exchanges a look with Junior and begins unlacing her skates.

s01092.summary: Hester and Pascal trade terse conditions without looking at each other.
Hester makes tea and sets a mug by Pascal, who ignores it.
Hester needles Pascal's curt replies until he smiles and takes the mug.
Hester asks if anyone else is coming, knowing no one is.
Pascal and Hester remember the full squad and their cox Camille.
Pascal voices his fear of missing the cut.
Hester turns the old stopwatch over and promises they'll row anyway.
Together they lift a single shell and carry it into the mist.

s01056.summary: Duchess convenes her crew in the abandoned carousel amid wry banter.
Slim lays out the four million hidden in the non-turning column.
Duchess explains they'll get in by pretending to belong, with permits.
Duchess assigns Pearl to drive and pick locks, dodging her cut demand.
Bones reveals a mysterious sixth share in Lavalle's ledger.
Duchess quietly accuses Lavalle, who coolly admits he misled her.

s01110.summary: Cornelius sits in his car as the family answering machine picks up.
Cornelius begins a message to his estranged daughter Mara.
He tells Mara her mother is hospitalized and asked about her.
He admits he bought the flowers himself and lied to make her smile.
He shares the uncertain prognosis and tells her where to find them.
He remembers her off-key singing and asks her to sing something.
He waits, hears only static, and the machine saves the message.

s01062.summary: Naomi and Emery wait on a stranded bus whose driver vanished.
Emery hears tapping and Naomi insists it's just the cold.
The tapping returns and Emery resolves to check the luggage rack.
Both stand in the aisle, hesitating and speaking in eerie unison.
The tapping stops and a duffel bag unzips by itself.
They back to the emergency door and Emery gropes for the lever.
Pale fingers emerge as Emery yanks the door and they tumble out.
They crawl away without looking back as a hand taps the glass.

s01091.summary: Irina and Kofi take cover as the Courier holds Hayes hostage.
The Courier orders the agents to drop their weapons.
Irina whispers a plan to draw the Courier away from Hayes.
A rolled coin distracts him, Kofi fires, and Irina charges into a brawl.
Kofi seizes the gun and Irina cuffs the surrendering Courier.
Freed Hayes reveals the Courier was warning him about the Directorate.
Irina asks if it's true and the Courier warns they're four minutes out.
They race for the stairwell as hostile headlights sweep the garage.

s01041.summary: The group settles into the cozy shanty, chatting about cold and bites.
Teddy hooks a big fish that fights and gets away.
Everyone settles into the warm quiet as snow ticks on the roof.
Brigid asks about the groaning ice and the locals explain it away.
The groan returns and Teddy hears humming; the adults dismiss him in unison.
Humming rises from under the floor and Ansel wakes, begging no hands in holes.
A pale hand rises from the hole and takes Teddy's mitten.

pd_sisters_6.summary: Varya waves an umbrella from a bundle, startling Lopakhin.
Trofimov hurries everyone to the train as Varya tearfully finds his galoshes.
Lopakhin locks up and the household bids farewell and exits.
Left alone, Lubov and Gaev embrace and sob quietly for the orchard.
Called by Anya and Trofimov, Lubov takes a last look and leaves.
The house falls silent, axes sound, and ailing Fiers shuffles in.
Fiers finds the door locked and realizes he has been forgotten.
Fiers lies down motionless as a string breaks and the axe falls.

s01045.summary: Leonard struggles through goat yoga while a goat eats his sock.
Mama Rose calls mid-class and Claudette answers on speaker.
Mama Rose suspects a boyfriend and insults Leonard over the speaker.
Mama Rose demands Claudette come home to fix the faucet.
Beyonce bleats triumphantly and Claudette says goodbye to Mama.
Claudette resettles and resumes the class with Warrior One.

s01100.summary: The crew goes about quiet routines while Iris gazes at Earth.
Waldemar quietly worries about the commander and Yasmin reassures him.
Iris announces a six-month extension and delayed crew rotation.
Iris talks about tomatoes while the crew resign themselves.
Iris orders four teas and Halcyon reminds her there are three.
Iris walks away and Waldemar asks who the fourth was.

s01034.summary: Beatrix, Nico and Fenwick notice the fox is missing an eye.
Beatrix challenges Fenwick's claim that nobody came in.
Beatrix pulls a note from the fox and stops Fenwick sneaking out.
Nico reads that the eye is in the owl; all turn.

s01087.summary: Ezekiel complains the lock is taking longer than Hosea promised.
Clementine corrects Ezekiel's timing and talks back when insulted.
Perpetua tells Ezekiel to let Hosea work as they bicker about a train.
A rope snaps and everyone scrambles to steady the lurching barge.
Officers on the towpath order the barge to halt in the Crown's name.
A humbled Ezekiel urges Hosea to open the upper gate now.
Hosea weighs his family and the Ardens, then cranks the upper sluice.
The barge shoots into the dark channel, leaving the officers behind.

s01109.summary: Billie tests the old scoreboard controls and blasts the horn by mistake.
The janitor checks in and Billie asks for five more minutes.
Billie spotlights center court and gazes at the empty circle.
Billie calls tip off and runs the home score up to 99.
She sounds a final horn, whispers good game, and kills the lights.

s00001.summary: Detective Odalys arrives at a taxidermy shop and is invited to sit.
Odalys probes about the museum break-in and lays a verbal trap.
The woman gives her name, and a museum key tag sits behind her.
Ingrid slyly reveals she knows the guard is a woman.
Odalys rises, hand to her belt, ordering Ingrid to drop the needle.

s01098.summary: Rosemary dismisses Benedict's offer to handle things at the funeral home.
Delphine butts in, claiming she is named in the will.
Rosemary admits she struck Delphine's paragraph, and insults fly.
Rosemary sags at the casket and Benedict lays a hand on her arm.
They agree he'd have loved the shouting and laugh through tears.
Funeral director Oswald checks in and Rosemary asks for a moment.
Delphine sits beside Rosemary; the three face the casket together.

s01033.summary: In the stalled car, Silas accuses August of pulling the brake.
August stops Silas reaching for his pocket and invokes their boss.
August hints he knows Silas took it, eyeing the briefcase.
Scrapes on the roof rock the car; August claims it's a deer.
Zofia drops through the roof hatch with an ice axe.
Zofia forces Silas to open the briefcase.
The briefcase is empty and Silas claims not to know where it is.
August points to a small handprint on the outside of the glass.
The car drops ten feet and catches as all three scream.

s01090.summary: Bruised Nell sits alone in the orchard eating a tasteless pear.
Theo steps from the trees and stops ten paces away.
Theo remarks on sides and rumors; Nell deflects.
Nell offers a pear and they eat together in silence.
Theo reveals his brother has been gone since June.
Nell finds a fleeting song on the radio and they listen together.
A woman calls a name, and Nell says it's for a girl she was.
Theo offers his hand and, after a pause, Nell takes it.
Mrs. Dunning appears and studies them as Theo shields Nell.
Mrs. Dunning leaves the door open and the teens follow her in.
